candidate.subject: government
candidate.question: Delegated legislation is the power to make laws by

candidate.explanation: Delegated legislation is made by bodies or officials acting under authority granted by the legislature. Parliament sets the enabling framework while the delegated body makes rules within that authority.

endanger national securit y C. slow and unwieldy process of decision making in legislative houses D.

records.hold_reason: Administrative expertise and the time-consuming parliamentary process are both recognized reasons for delegated legislation. The printed alternatives allow more than one defensible justification.

options.B: the legislative and the executive work together
options.C: the executive is elected for a fixed term
options.D: the judiciary will overrule the impeachment of the cabinet

records.source_excerpt:
10. The principle of collective responsibility does not operate under the presidential system of
government because
A. cabinet members are responsible people B. the legislative and the executive work together
C. the executive is elected for a fixed te rm D. the judiciary will overrule the impeachm ent of the
cabinet
records.hold_reason: A fixed executive term does not itself explain the absence of parliamentary collective responsibility. The options omit ministers accountability to the president and separation from confidence votes.
